# Morea Evidence Pack

> Morea is a non-commercial educational research prototype (personal reskilling) for practising an EU AI Act Article 4 literacy Evidence Pack: AI-use inventory, role-aware literacy module, quiz, optional policy draft, and a dated SHA-256-verified export. It is not a compliance service, not legal advice, and not a product for sale. Live at https://morea-pack.vercel.app.

## Key facts
- Article 4 applies since 2 February 2025. Digital Omnibus on AI (mid-2026) clarified: take measures to support literacy development; no requirement to guarantee any individual’s literacy level.
- Applies to providers and deployers in the EU.
- Morea produces an illustrative Evidence Pack for learning — not auditor-grade attestation.
- Local verification: upload evidence-pack.json at /verify.html.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://morea-pack.vercel.app/): Morea Evidence Pack overview
- [Inventory](https://morea-pack.vercel.app/inventory.html): AI-use inventory
- [Exposure intake](https://morea-pack.vercel.app/assess.html): 6-question classification
- [Verify](https://morea-pack.vercel.app/verify.html): JSON hash check / demo code lookup
